note: Not an election: the member for this seat on 1 January 1801, when the Irish House of Commons was merged into the House of Commons of the United Kingdom by the Act of Union; the History of Parliament's page for the constituency names the member for 1801. The second seat was vacant at the Union: Beresford's seat had fallen vacant when he succeeded to the peerage as marquess of Waterford; Sir George Fitzgerald Hill was elected to it on 14 Jan. 1801.
